explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 523 days after the shortage posting

sentences.text: The FDA shortage posting for cefotetan dates to 2014-08-14 and has remained on the list for 146 months as of 2026-10-21.

A registered plant on the Fresenius Kabi label, ACS Dobfar S.p.A. (FEI 3006028606), received an OAI classification after an inspection that ended 2016-01-19, which was 523 days after the shortage posting.
That same plant had prior VAI inspections ending 2012-03-27, 2014-03-18, and 2014-05-23, with the last two occurring 149 and 83 days before the shortage posting.
A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2017-01-13, and subsequent inspections through 2024-12-13 have been classified VAI.
The P&T-approved interchange from PAI Holdings (NDC 00121097610) to Fresenius Kabi (NDC 63323038510) was authorized by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-04-28.
Current inventory across three sites provides 11 to 25 days on hand at present usage rates.

Q-c6746f.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%cefotetan%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%cefotetan%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-daec27.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('f1510f5e-d001-44e0-accb-27cf79fd4f9a', 'bd22c66b-8a1c-44c8-b5b6-3ab0ce5c800e') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-a92bef.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%cefotetan%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-b56d8c.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%cefotetan%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-e30bdd.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%cefotetan%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-efa11b.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3006028606', '3002807084') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-a0277e.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3006028606', '3002807084') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-674018.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3006028606', '3002807084') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('acs dobfar', 'pai pharm')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-3a3b1e.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('acs dobfar', 'pai pharm', 'pai dba pai', 'fresenius kabi') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%cefotetan%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-4aec48.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('955350') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-3b414c.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00121097610', '63323038510')
